summary: Iter47 Phase 3 — Deep Monthly Supplier Statement + strict Vehicle→Supplier link. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases in test_iter47_phase3_supplier_deep.py PASS. Extra ad-hoc verification confirms PDF text-extract contains 'OPENING BALANCE', 'CLOSING BALANCE', 'MOVEMENTS · DEBITS (+)', 'MOVEMENTS · CREDITS (−)' labels; POST /api/reports/supplier-statement/share accepts opening_mode and returns a valid whatsapp_url. All supplier_id enforcement paths verified: (a) supplier vehicle w/o link → 400 with 'supplier' in detail, (b) supplier_id → OK, (c) supplier_name only → auto-resolves/creates and echoes real supplier_id, (d) PUT wiping supplier_id/name → 400. Deep block math verified: opening (5000 payable) + 20000 freight − 3000 advance = 22000 Dr closing; carry_forward correctly computes previous-period closing (12000) as next-period opening. Frontend: Reports → Supplier Statement page verified end-to-end via Playwright — ss-supplier-select populated, ss-opening-mode dropdown shows both options ('Opening: From Master' / 'Opening: Carry Forward'), ss-deep-blocks renders both cards, opening=₹500 Dr, closing=₹8,500 Dr, switching opening_mode re-fetches. TripForm verified via code review: form.vehicle_type='supplier' conditionally renders trip-supplier-picker; onSubmit blocks with toast 'Please select a Supplier for this supplier vehicle (mandatory)'; picking a supplier vehicle from vehicle master auto-populates supplier_id + supplier_name (lines 417-418 and 964-966).
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py > _supplier_deep_statement_blocks: `movements_debit` includes `payments_in_total` (receipts back from supplier) AND `_supplier_ledger_closing` handles receipts as +running. Consistent. Good.

_supplier_ledger_closing rebuilds the ledger on every carry_forward request (O(trips+payments per supplier)). For large history, consider caching per (supplier, month) or precomputed monthly closings.

trips.py > _enforce_supplier_link auto-creates Supplier master when only name is given. This is convenient but silently mutates master data — consider surfacing a UI toast/warning informing the user a new supplier was created.
TripForm.jsx > onSubmit toast text 'Please select a Supplier for this supplier vehicle (mandatory)' — matches the 'select a Supplier' phrase required by review request.
seed_data_creation: Iter47 tests create ephemeral IT47Sup-* suppliers, IT47Cust-* customers, and AP99IT47* trips. Also created ShareTest-* + one trip via ad-hoc share verification (used by frontend Playwright run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter47 Phase 3 is fully green. Regression: run pytest backend/tests/test_iter47_phase3_supplier_deep.py. The frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage (not cookie) — direct fetch() with credentials:include returns 401; use api client wrapper or set Authorization header. rca of the issue: No bugs found. All Iter47 Phase 3 acceptance criteria met.
